newsitem.title: USA: Three firms buy $91 mln Nassau County, N.Y., BANs.
newsitem.headline: Three firms buy $91 mln Nassau County, N.Y., BANs.

text.p: Nassau County, N.Y., sold $90.6 million of bond anticipation notes (BANs) through competitive auction on Wednesday.
Roosevelt & Cross Inc. bought $60.6 million of the notes with a 4.25 percent coupon and a 3.916 percent net interest cost.
Bear Stearns & Co. bought $25 million of the notes with a 4.50 percent coupon and 3.760 percent net interest cost.
And A.H. Williams & Co. bought $15 million of the notes with a 4.25 percent coupon and 3.903 percent net interest cost.
